title: [review] project-LICHEN-iaui.3: EdhocResponder::new Ok(Self) with Self return type
description: In rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs line 1034, EdhocResponder::new declares return type -> Self but the body returns Ok(Self { ... }) which should be type Result<Self, _>. This compiles on rustc 1.96.1 but is fragile; a compiler upgrade or different feature set could reject it. The sibling EdhocInitiator::new at line 687 has the same pattern but returns Self body (no Ok wrapper). Fix the return type or the body to be consistent.
